tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba'i cho ga gsal bar bshad pa 'gro kun mkha' spyod bsgrod pa'i nye lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ bka' drin mnyam med mus pa chen po dang / /mkha' spyod dbang mo'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ /de yi byin rlabs dbang bzhi cho ga'i tshul/ /'gro kun mkha' spyod bsgrod pa'i nye lam spel/ /de la 'dir don du gnyer ba'i slob ma gcig nas nyer lnga'i bar zung du ma gyur pa rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la/ las kyi slob mas me tog bkye bsdu tshar ba dang / slob dpon gyis 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i tshul du gsan la/ don zab mo thugs nyams su bzhes snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gdul bya so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par chos kyi tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa'i nang nas/ zab pa las kyang ches mchog tu zab pa ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam yin zhing / de la yang rgyud sde'i dbye sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs yod kyang / da lan 'dir skabs su bab pa/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud las/ ji srid mdo bya spyod pa ni/ /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba las/ /sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ /de dang de la dga' ba yi/ /zhes rgyud sde sgo drug tu gsungs pa'i nang nas ma'i yang ma bla na med pa 'khor lo bde mchog gi rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i rgyud rnams la/ yab lū nag dril gsum dang / yum phag mo'i lam rim pa rnams gsungs pa la brten nas/ yab la nag po gzhung drug lū hi pa'i smad lnga/ dril bu gzhung gsum dang / yum la phag mo mkha' spyod kyi skor rnams las/

da lam yum gyi skor yin zhing / de yang yab dril bu pa'i lus dkyil dang / yum gyi byin rlabs rnams kyi sngon du/ rgyud yongs su ma smin pa smin par byed pa phyi'i dkyil 'khor du nges par dbang bskur dgos la/ dbang de yang kyai rdor lta bu rgyud sde zab mo gzhan rnams nas gsungs pa gang rung tsam thob pa las byas na skyon med dam snyam na/ slob dpon la gsang sgrogs kyi nyes pa rang mi 'byung yang / slob ma'i rgyud la rtogs pa skye ba'i byin rlabs dang lam bsgrod pa la khyad par shin tu che bas na/ lū nag gang rung gi dkyil 'khor du rgyud yongs su smin pa'i gang zag la dgos kyi smin byed lta bu/ yab la dril bu lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang / yum la byin rlabs kyi rim pa rnams thob dgos la/ de ltar smin byed kyi dbang rnams thob nas/ rje btsun gyi yum la grol byed kyi lam yang bskyed pa'i rim pa nā ro mkha' spyod/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma/ lam gyi yan lag pra sen na dbab pa/ sman chen po'i bcud len/ gnod sbyin mo dbang du bya ba la sogs pa rnams su 'dus la/ bskyed pa'i rim pa ni rtsa rgyud nas/ rnal 'byor ma'i nye snying la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thabs gsungs pa nā ros phyung nas mdzad la/ rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma la chags can pho nya'i lam ni yab la sbyor ba dang / chags bral rnal 'byor gyi lam ni rje btsun nā ro ta pas pham mthing pa la yum la sbyar nas gnang bas yum gyi rtsa dbu ma zhes grags pa ltar yin la/ pra sen na sogs las gsum ni rgyud nas thun mong du gsungs pas yab yum gnyis ka la rung ba nyid yin zhing / spyir gyi mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thabs la/ rje btsun yab la brten pa/ yum la brten pa/ skye ba bdun pa'i sha la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa ste lugs mi 'dra ba gsum las/ 'dir byin rlabs shin tu myur ba rje btsun yum la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thabs de nyid nyams su len par byed pa la/

thog mar dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur dgos pa las/ de ltar skur ba po rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ rab bde mchog lū nag gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa/ 'bring 'khor lo bde mchog gang rung / mtha' na'ang kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs lta bu gnyis med rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gang rung du dbang thob cing / 'di'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs legs par nos nas/ bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig dang / rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma'i khrid sogs dang / de dag gi rgyab rten rgyud dang rgya bod kyi gzhung tshad ldan bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsan yig las 'byung ba ltar gyi nā ro mkha' spyod kyi chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa rnams kyi bshad pa dang / lung la sogs pa mtha' chod par thob nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yum rkyang ngam/ yab yum gnyis med kyi sgo nas sarba bud+dha la bzhi 'bum la sogs pa'i bsnyen pa las su rung ba zhig byung na mchog tu gyur par gsungs la/ gal te nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid sogs chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa ma thob cing / rnal 'byor ma yum rkyang ngam/ bde mchog yab yum gnyis med kyi sgo nas sarba bud+dha la bzhi 'bum sogs kyi bsnyen pa ma grub kyang / gong du bshad pa ltar gyi dbang byin rlabs tshul bzhin du thob cing / kyai rdo rje lta bu'i gzhi'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin pa zhig ni lugs 'di'i rdo rje slob dpon bya ba la cis kyang dgos pa yin te/ deng sang dpal ldan sa skya pa'i grub mtha'i srol 'dzin gyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal che ba'i phyag len de kho nar mdzad pa dang / sngon gyi bla ma gong ma 'khrul pa zad pa rnams kyis kyang de dang 'dra ba kho na 'byung bas/ rang re rjes 'jug rnams kyis thugs rtog zhib len mdzad pa gal che ba yin la/ de lta bu'i mtshan nyid ci rigs tshang ba'i slob dpon gyi bgyi bar 'os pa bdag nyid lhar bskyed cing bzlas pa bya ba/

mdun gyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa/ bum pa sgrub pa/ slob dpon rang nyid kyis slob ma la dbang ji tsam bskur ba bdag 'jug gi tshul du blang ba dang / yi dam chos skyong sogs la gtor ma 'bul ba'i bar legs par bgyis zin pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa/ slob ma'i bya ba la 'jug pa dang / dngos gzhi gnyis su yod pa las/ thog mar 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ zhes brjod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzad pa zhu/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo bsgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor mas/ /bdag la byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ /de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ khyed rang rnams kyis sngon chad sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor ma gzigs pa'am/ gzigs kyang skyar nas gzigs pa'i mtshon byed du dar yug dmar po re spyan dar du bcing ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing gdong ras bcing / dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba de'i tshe phyag stong par mjal mi rung bas na u dum bā ra la sogs pa'i me tog gi 'phreng ba re phyag tu gtad dgos pas/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtad/ slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs kha nas khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dpag tu med pa spros/ khyed rang rnams byin rlabs zab mo zhu ba la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sum+bha ni brjod cing bum chu slob ma la gtor/

khyed rang rnams kyis bdud rtsi myangs pa la brten nas lus kyi nang thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing nang gi bar chad thams cad las bsrung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing nang mchod nas bdud rtsi lag pa g.yon par byin/ de nas khyed rang rnams la 'dod pa dri dgos pas/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga' zhes dris pa'i lan btab par mos nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /zhes dang / des bu la ci zhig bya/ zhes dris pa'i lan btab par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /de nas nang gi sems bskyed pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba lta bu/ de'i steng du don dam byang chub kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa ste bden pa gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa ta ya mi/ de nyid slob dpon gyis khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar rdo rje bzhag pa'i sgo nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ su ra ti sa ma ya satwaṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya tha su khaṃ/ zhes brjod cing slob ma du yod kyi snying khar rdo rje dngos su reg tsam re bya/ de nas 'og nas 'byung ba'i gsang sngags kyi kun tu spyod pa rnams snod dang mi ldan pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar ma byed cig ces gsang bar gdams pa yin te/ deng khyod rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su bzhugs kyis/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /zhes brjod cing rdo rje mgo thog tu bzhag khyed rang rnams slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i drung du khrid par mos nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la mgo dud pa re mdzad nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod/ de ltar khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs nas rgyud 'dag par bya ba'i phyir dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams 'khod nas skyabs su 'gro zhing sdig pa bshags pa dang / gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang zhing / don dam pa dang / smon pa dang / 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang / yongs su bsngo ba la sogs pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes bzlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab sgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyid/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /de ltar rgyud dag par byas nas thun mong ma yin pa rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gis bsdus pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams kyang gzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang /

/sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gi sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gi bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gi dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /ces lan gsum brjod/ slar yang 'khor lo bde mchog thun mong ma yin pa khyad par gyi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyang tshul bzhin du bsrung sdom gyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ /kun la'ang bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo/ /rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag gis dus 'di nas bzung ste/

/ji srid gnyis med la gnas bar/ /de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung / /de rnams kyi sgo nas dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs legs par bzung nas/ dngos gzhi'i rim pa la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba dang / mdun gyi sin+dhu ri'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka na 'od 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyi phyi nang thams cad gang zhing khyab pas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs/ 'od zer rnams gcig tu 'dus te khyed rang rnams kyi lte ba'i dbus su chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi nang du bam̐ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas par gyur/ de las 'od zer phyir 'phros pas phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang dang / nang bcud kyi sems can rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ 'od zer tshur 'dus khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma brdzis shing / g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu ltab pa'i gdong pa mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar po bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭaṃ ka la ḍā ma ru dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang ba dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan zhing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i sku can du gyur pa'i lte bar e yig nyis brtsegs yongs su gyur pa las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi steng du bam̐ yig dmar po dang /

de'i mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhi smin mtshams kyi thad rnams su dga' ba 'khyil pa re re dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ phaiṃ slob dpon gyi thugs kha nas 'od 'phros 'og min nas rje btsun rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ dpon slob gnyis kas 'khyud rgya bcas/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmā yo ga shud+dha3haṃ/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar po rdo rje phag mo/ snying kar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hring moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo bskyed byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo rnams gsal bar gyur/ ces brjod/ de ltar khyed rang rnams rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gsal ba'i lte bar e e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su bam̐/ mdun rgyab spangs pa'i chos 'byung gi grwa bzhi dang khyed rang rnams kyi smin mtshams kyi thad kar bde ba'i rang bzhin dga' ba 'khyil pa re re yod par mos pa mdzad nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pas bdag la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum brjod/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs kha nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam re rgyangs kyis byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/

oṃ gsum ma brjod cing gong du bshams pa'i zan ril gyi sdong ras sbar nas slob ma rnams kyi khar bcug la khyur mid gyis shig bsgos/ de ltar zhal du zhugs pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de nyid dmar 'khyug ste rtsa dag pa dbu ma'i lam brgyud de/ spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar la gar stabs kyis rnam pas yar 'khyug mar 'khyug mdzad/ ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i gegs su gyur pa'i nang gi mi gtsang ba dang ma dag pa thams cad bsal nas/ mthar lte ba'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi nang gi bam̐ yig dang 'dres pa'i rkyen gyis de nyid kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhabs brkyangs pa'i zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ de lta bu'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de nyid la sems gtad pas de nyid bde ba chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su gang bas gar stabs du ma mdzad cing chos 'byung gi grwa bzhi dang / khyed rang rnams kyi smin mtshams kyi thad kar dga' ba 'khyil pa ste lnga ka'ang bde ba'i nyams dang ldan pa dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ g.yon phyogs su myur du 'khor ba la sems gtod pa zhu/ slob dpon gyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs brgyud bskul/ yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo dang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas sib sib thim pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la/

las kyi rdo rjes gu gul gdug rol mo bya zhing oṃ gsum ma bzla/ slar yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ sngar gyi mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka nas/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku dpag tu med pa tshad med grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa ltar byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas gnyis su med par thim pa la brten nas ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod cing spos rol sogs gong bzhin bya/ de ltar khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la ye shes skyes pa'i rtags su/ lus kyi ba spu ldang ba/ ngag gis sngags bzla/ yid la mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye ba la sogs pa nyams kyi snang ba cung zad re mi skye ba mi srid pas de lam gyi dus su bskyang dgos pa yin la/ de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor slob dpon gyis rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag pa'i sgo nas brten par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra brjod/ slob ma re re'i mgo thog tu rdo rje rgya gram bzhag de nas khyed rang rnams kyi phyag na yod pa'i me tog gi 'phreng ba rnams thogs te gral rim bzhin bzhengs nas/ 'di na sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bzhugs pa'i dbu thog tu 'bul snyam pas/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes gsungs shing 'bul ba'i stang ka re mdzod/ de nas slob dpon gyis me tog gi 'phreng ba sngags kyi 'phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas mgo thog tu bzhag par mos la/ oṃ pra ti gh+rih+ṇa satwa i maṃ satwa mahā ba la/ zhes brjod cing me tog slob ma'i mgo la reg tsam re bya/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i sgrib byed bsal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ rnal 'byor ma dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong gyur pa/

/rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭaṃ laṃ hrīḥ zhes brjod la gdong ras phye/ de ltar khyed rang rnams kyi mi shes pa'i mig gi rab rib bsal nas ye shes kyi mig thob ste sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum lta bur mthong ba yin snyam pa'i mos pa mdzad nas/ gang la lta ba'i dkyil 'khor yang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor yin te/ 'og tu sku tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng gi thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du thugs sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor te/ de yang sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du/ rdo rje'i sa bzhi/ ra ba dra ba/ gur/ bla bre/ phyi rol mda'i dra ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhes pa nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod/ de ltar na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad sku dang tsa ka li lta bu ma yin pa snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar mngon sum lta bur mthong ba yin no/ /ces brjod cing bsam pa de yan gyis 'jug pa'i chos yan lag dang bcas pa song nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ zhes brjod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar mdzod/ rnal 'byor ma dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyobs pa'i gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas gtso/ /de bzhin bdag la'ang deng stsol cig /de ltar gsol ba btab nas khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su dbang stegs rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/

g.yas su rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du ba dan/ 'khor yug tu mchod pa sna tshogs kyis bskor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma pheṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmā yo ga shud+dha haṃ/ zhes brjod la 'khyud rgya byed du gzhug khyed rang rnams kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo sogs go cha bgod/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar pheṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de ltar mngon sum lta bur byon pa'i skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi he ru ka yab yum gyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhis rdo rje'i glu len/ khaṇ+ḍa ka pa li la sogs pa'i dpa' bo rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa'i dpa' mo rnams mchod pa byed/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bgegs rnams bskrad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la slob dpon gyis dril bsil dang bcas pas/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba'i/ /he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku/ /shes rab phag mo'i pad+mar rdo rjes rol mdzad pa'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /ces brjod/ de nas dbang gi don du gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas slob dpon skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la bum pa thogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/

/de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ ka ka s+ye/ u lu ka s+ye/ shwa na s+ya/ pu ka ra s+ya/ ya ma da dhi ye/ ya ma ma du ti ye/ ya ma daṃṣ+ṭi ṇ+ye/ ya ma tha ni ye/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor bum pa bzhag la/ lag pa g.yon par bum chu byin/ de ltar bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad re res dbu brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis khyed rang rnams khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol zhing dbang bskur ba la slob dpon gyis kyang rab tu gnas pa'i sgo nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor me tog gtor la/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la gnyis su med pa thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar khyed rang rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rang bzhin du gnas pa la slob dpon gyis mchod pas mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gi bar phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ de nas bzlas pa'i lung sbyin pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i thugs kha dang / slob dpon gyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du bam̐ yig dmar po'i mtha' mar sngags 'phreng gis bskor bar mos/ slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i bam̐ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las/ sngags 'phreng gnyis pa mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung / slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi bam̐ yig la thim zhing / de'i mtha' mar g.yon bskor du dang pos 'khod/ gnyis pas byin gyis brlabs/ gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/

ces brjod la oṃ gsum ma lan gsum brjod/ de nas khyed rang rnams slob dpon la me tog 'thor la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis me tog 'phreng ba sngags kyi 'phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang / oṃ gsum ma tshar gcig tsam brjod/ de nas slob ma rnams la me tog gtor zhing / bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes slob ma mang nyung la dpags nas ji ltar rigs pa brjod/ 'di'i mtshams su dam bca' re len par phyag len la mdzad pas/ 'di lta bu'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi zab mo'i lam gyi dbang byin rlabs/ gdams pa'i tshogs rnams legs par thob nas/ gang zag dbang po rab kyis bzlas sgom kho na chag med du nyams su len cing / 'di rang gi bsnyen pa mthar phyin par byas/ yar ngo'i tshes bcu dang / mar ngo'i nyer lnga ste tshes bcu gnyis la mchod pa la brtson par byas pa tsam gyis/ re zhig na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ tha mal gyi bud med kyi rnam par 'byon zhing / de ltar byon pa de nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pa la yin par ngo shes/ des rnal 'byor mas lag pa'i 'khrig ma nas bzung ste lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du 'khyer bar bshad cing / gang zag dbang po 'bring gis de ltar nyams su blangs kyang rtags sogs ci yang ma byung na/ 'di rang gi bsnyen pa yi ge'i grangs kyi 'bum tshar gnyis tsam bzlas pa'i bsnyen pa dang / laṅka ling ka'i shing la brten nas sin+dhu ra bsgrub pa'i sgrub pa byas/ de rjes sin+dhu ra de rang gi dpral bar dga' ba 'khyil pa bri zhing / 'phongs ra lta bu bud med mang du 'tshogs pa'i sar phyin nas/ rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal brtan pos bltas pa'i tshe/

bud med gang gi dpral bar me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin dga' 'khyil 'phos na/ de nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid yin pas/ g.yon nas bskor ba dang gsol ba btab pas/ des rang gi mkhrig ma nas bzung ste mkha' spyod du 'khyer bar gsungs pa ni/ 'bring bsnyen sgrub las gsum la brten nas mkha' spyod bsgrub pa zhes bya ba yin la/ gang zag dbang po tha mas de lta bu'i bya ba ma grub pa'am/ grub kyang ji lta ba bzhin ma byung na/ da dung sgyid lug mi bya bar bzlas sgom nan tan du nyams su blangs pas/ nam zhig 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku las/ bar dor langs pa na/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bzlas sgom byed pa'i snang ba 'byung zhing / de la brten nas dus de nyid du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pas sgrub pa po de seṅge'i khri la bzhag 'ja' gur phub/ me tog gi char 'bebs bzhin pas mkha' spyod du 'khyer ba ni nges pa yin par gsungs pa ste/ mdor na dbang po rab 'bring sus nyams su blangs kyang mkha' spyod sgrub pa la thabs 'di bas lhag pa cung zad kyang med pas/ de la da lta nas bsgom bzlas la brtson par bya dgos pa yin pas khyed rang rnams nyi ma re la sngags ji tsam bzla/ zhes re re nas dris tshar ba dang / 'o khyed rang rnams kyis khas blangs pa'i dam bca' de rnams thugs la zhogs la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ rang rang gi ming nas brjod de/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus da nas bzung ste mkha' spyod kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yi dam gyi lhar bzung zhing / de'i gsang sngags kyang dam bca' bzhin bzla bar bgyi'o/ lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis slob ma'i mgor me tog gtor la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal legs kyi/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi byin rlabs ni/

/'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rig pa 'dzin pa rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis sin+dhu ra'i rdul tshon nas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du reg pa la brten nas bum dbang gi byin rlabs brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod/ de ltar na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas bum pa'i dbang byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lam bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes brjod/ de yan gyis bum dbang bzlas lung dang bcas pa song nas/ da gsang dbang byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang snyoms par bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i thig le dung dang kun+da ltar dkar ba thod pa'i nang du lhung ba slob dpon gyis khyed rang rnams kyi lce thog tu bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ gsum ma dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ rjod bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'og gi thod pa'i bdud rtsi nas slob ma rnams kyi lag pa g.yon par byin/ de ltar bdud rtsi byin pa de nyid mgrin par myangs pa la brten nas rim gyis brgyud lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad khyab pas khyed rang rnams kyi rtsa nang gi byang sems dam tshig pa'i tshul dang dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres pas/ rang bzhin brgyad bcu'i rtog pa dbyings su dag cing gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par bsam la cung zad gcig mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/

de ltar na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas gsang ba'i dbang byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ lam rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma ut+pa la gzhon nu kha 'byed pa'i man ngag bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas dbang gsum pa byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru kar gyur pa dang / rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems de nyid khyed rang rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i kha nang du byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang / sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi dga' 'khyil sngags 'phreng bam̐ yig dang bcas pa nas srin lag g.yon pas blangs nas khyed rang rnams kyi gsang gnas lte ba snying ga mgrin pa skra mtshams rnams su reg cing thig le byas nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod cing dngos su slob dpon gyi g.yon pa'i srin lag gis/ gsang gnas/ lte ba/ snying kha/ mgrin pa/ skra mtshams rnams su yas mar reg pa'i tshul bya zhing / oṃ gsum ma bzla bzhin pa'i ngang nas thig le bya ba yin te/ de yang lte ba la thig le byed dus slob dpon gyi srin lag g.yon pas sin+dhu re blangs/ slob ma'i srin lag g.yon par bskus la slob ma rang gi gsang gnas dang lte ba la bsku ru 'jug snying kha/ mgrin pa/ skra mtshams rnams su slob dpon gyis bya/ de ltar sin+dhu ra'i thig le byas shing kha nang du byin pa'i byang sems de nyid 'og rlung bskyod pa'i stobs kyis yar drangs/ lte ba'i rtsa 'khor thams cad byang sems kyis khrig mer gang bas dga' ba'i ye shes/ yar drangs snying ga'i rtsa 'khor thams cad gang bas mchog dga'i ye shes/

yar drangs mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor thams cad gang bas dga' bral gyi ye shes/ yar drangs spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor thams cad gang bas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems de nyid rlung dang 'khrul 'khor la sogs pa'i sgo nas lus la 'gram pas lus thams cad la rtsas khyab/ de thams cad la byang chub sems kyis khyab/ des khyab tshad la bde bas khyab/ bde ba la stong pas khyab pa ste mdor na bde stong zung 'jug gi ngang du snyoms par 'jog bzhin pas 'khyud rgya dang bcas te sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ta badz+ra swa bhā ba at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod la cung zad cig mnyam par bzhag de ltar na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ lam phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas dbang bzhi pa byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams rkang pa skyil krung lag pa mnyam bzhag rgal tshigs drang por bsrang ba la sogs pa lus bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis gnas par byas/ ngag rlung rgyu ba sor bzhag la sems kyi/ dngos po med pa'i chos nyid chos/ /nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med/ /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yis/ /stong pa nyid du rnam par bsgom/ /zhes pa ste/ de'i don yang 'di yin te/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs bden pa'i dngos po cung zad tsam yang ye gdod ma nas yod ma myong ba chos rnams kyi chos nyid ces bya ba/ de ni yod med rtag chad srid zhi'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bas nam mkha' lta bu gang du yang ma grub pa ltar/ sems kyang gang du yang ma grub pa ste/ dang po skye ba rgyus stong /

bar du gnas pa ngo bos stong / mtha' mar 'gag pa 'bras bus stong pa ste/ rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin yin la/ de'ang stong pa stong rkyang ma yin pa khyed rang rnams kyi lus rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsal la ma 'gag pa de gsal ba dang ma bral ba de'i thugs rgyud zag med kyi bdud rtsis gang bas na/ bde ba dang ma bral ba ste/ bde stong zung 'jug gam/ gsal stong zung 'jug gi ngang la cung zad gcig mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de ltar na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i sgo nas dbang bzhi pa byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de rnams kyi sgo nas rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba de nyid legs par thob pa yin pas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /lan gsum/ dbang bskur zab mo thob pa'i gtang rag tu dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ lus longs spyod la sogs pa yang yon du 'bul zhing / cha shas kyis longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran tu/ /khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags kyi/ /khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ de ltar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang mkha' spyod thob pa la shin tu myur ba 'di yin zhing / de yang mkha' spyod chen po ni sangs rgyas kyi sa yin la/ mkha' spyod chung ngu ni 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can ci 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad nam mkha' las 'byung ba tshe nyi zla gnas kyi bar du thub cing /

rdzu 'phrul gyi nam mkha' la 'gro nus pas sprul sku las dngos su chos nod cing / sprul sku'i zhing khams thogs med du bsgrod nus pa/ tshe de la sangs rgya nges pa gcig yin par bshad la/ de ltar mchog tu zab cing sgrub thag nye ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam 'di la brten nas rgya bod kyi skyes chen grangs med pa zhig mkha' spyod du byon pa'i lo rgyus mang du 'byung yang / 'dir skal bzang spro ba bskyed pa'i bla ma gong ma'i gsung rgyun dang rnam thar sogs nas 'byung ba ltar rags tsam brjod na/ de yang rgya gar 'phags yul du/ grub chen dril bu pa/ dpal na ro pa chen po/ a bha ya ka ra sogs 'di'i lam la brten nas grub thob bya khyu 'phur ba ltar byung ba'i tshul dang / bod gangs can gyi khrod 'dir yang / pu hrang lo tsā bas lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod 'grub tshul/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba'i slob ma bsgom pa mo'i lo rgyus dang / rje btsun rin po che la mkha' spyod nas spyan 'dren byung tshul/ nam za brag phug pa'i nye gnas lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du byon tshul/ yang nam za brag phug pa'i slob ma bdun lus ma spangs par song tshul/ grub chen bud+dha pa'i slob ma zhe dgon pa'i dge slong de wa ma ti nyer lnga la mkha' spyod mas spyan drangs tshul/ bla ma dam pa mkha' spyod mas rjes su bzung tshul/ sngags 'chang gzungs dpal ba la rnal 'byor mas byu ru dmar po'i skas dngos su btsugs tshul/ bzang po rgyal mtshan gyi gdung la rnal 'byor ma rang byon 'khrungs tshul/ bla chen chos dpal sin+dhu ra'i sgrub pa mdzad pas khong gshegs dus rnal 'byor ma'i sku rang byon 'phel tshul/ khams pa bsod nams bzang po rnal 'byor mas mkha' spyod la dngos su khyer tshul/ shar chen ye rgyal la rnal 'byor mas/ 'chi ba zhes bya'i rnam rtog gis/ mkha' la 'gro ba'i gnas su khyer/ /zhes lung bstan pa dang /

rdo rje 'chang gi slob ma tshar ba rong pa shākya rgyal mtshan 'phan yul gyi ri las lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs tshul/ yang tsha rong pa bsod nams bzang po tsha rong gi ri las 'chi khar mkha' spyod du gshegs tshul/ rje sems dpa' chen po'i slob ma gsum mkha' spyod du dngos su gshegs pa'i lo rgyus dang / paṇa chen gung ru rnal 'byor mas dngos su rjes su bzung tshul/ chos rje sangs rgyas bzang po la rje btsun mas dbu zhwa'i nang rak+ta stsal tshul/ rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang la nang mchod kyi steng du rnal 'byor ma tshon gang pa dngos su byon nas zhal bstan tshul/ srad pa kun blo la rdo rje rnal 'byor mas mi'i bu mo dngos kyi rnam par bstan tshul dang khong byang chen du gshegs dus rnal 'byor mas bsu ba'i 'od dge ldan pas mthong bas brang brdungs tshul/ rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan pas 'pho ba legs par thebs tshul/ pu hrang rnal 'byor pa la rnal 'byor ma la brten nas bar chad bsal tshul dang gdung la rnal 'byor ma byon tshul/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros pa la mnal lam du rnal 'byor mas rjes su bzung tshul/ kun mkhyen rin po che dang sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis kyang rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba la brten nas bde ba can du gshegs tshul/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mal pa'i bud med kyi tshul sogs rnam sprul du mas mngon sum du zhal yang yang bstan tshul/ bdag gi bla ma rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang mi'i sku gzugs can de nyid la yang rta lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyi ma shar dros la bsam gtan phu'i gzim phug tu rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi bsu ba dngos su byon nas de dag dang gsung gleng mdzad pa rje dbon gyis gnam sgo'i steng gi gzim phug gi mdo nas thos tshul/ de nas nyer gcig gi nam la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i man ngag zab mo 'da' kha ma'i rnal 'byor gsal 'debs par mdzad de/

phaṭ che ba gnyis dang hik chung ngu zhig gsungs pa'i mod la/ de ma thag dbu las chu bskol ba lta bu'i rlangs pa chen po skya bun pa dang bcas skad cig nyid la dbu gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga zang thal du gyur pa nas rtsa dbu ma lta bu'i sbom phra smyug ma 'bring po tsam gyi rtsa sbub stong zhig rgyangs kyis thon pa las byang sems nyil le ba dang bcas thogs pa med par mkha' spyod chen po 'og min du gshegs pa'i tshul/ rnam thar thang sde pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan pas dge ldan pa'i sku mang po bshigs shing sdig pa bsags kyang / gshegs dus rnal 'byor ma la brten nas dbu gtsug 'phar tshul/ bla ma nam mkha' rdo rje'i gdung la oṃ gsum ma byon tshul/ bsgrub chen pa seṅge grags gshegs dus sin+dhu ra'i char bab tshul sogs te/ rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod 'di'i lam la brten nas dngos grub kyi mtshan ma thob pa'i lo rgyus mtha' yas pa zhig 'byung bas skal bzang dag 'di'i bzlas bsgom chag med du bgyid cing / bsnyen bsgrub sogs la 'bad pa dang / tshes bcu'i mchod pa bgyid pa'ang skal ba bzang por shes par byas nas yid dga' yal le/ shes pa spro sing nge ba'i ngang nas chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi rnam rtog rgyang ring du spangs te tshig don la sems rtse gcig tu bsgril te nyams su len par zhu/ de rnams kyi sgo nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs zab mo legs par thob pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya che ba mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /ces sogs brjod cing slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang ngo / /de ltar rje btsun mkha' spyod dbang mo yi/ /dbang bzhi byin rlabs cho ga'i lag len mchog /'gro kun mkha' spyod bsgrod pa'i nye lam 'di/ /sa skyar gnas pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes byas sbyar/ /dge ba 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/

/bdag gzhan 'gro ba'i sgrib pa kun byang nas/ /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /mkha' spyod dbang mos dag pa'i zhing khrid nas/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras bcas mnyes byas te/ /sprul pas sa skya'i bstan pa rgyas byed cing / /mthong thos dran reg gyur pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du 'dren gyur cig /ces pa'i yi ge pa ni rang dang nye bar gnas pa'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa byams pa dpal 'byor gyis gus spro'i sgo nas legs par bgyis so// //sarba maṅga laṃ// //ka l+ya na war+dhan+tu/ dge legs 'phel bar gyur/ zhus dag/ // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 20 a myes zhabs/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba'i cho ga gsal bar bshad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 19
